err_wrong_chain_address: This does not look like a valid {{chain}} address. Double-check you are sending on the right network.
qr_hint: Point your camera at the QR code to fill in the address.
qr_not_supported: QR scanning is not supported in this browser.
qr_camera_error: Could not access the camera. Please grant camera permission and try again.
qr_permission_needed: Camera access is needed to scan QR codes. Chrome can only show the permission prompt on a full page — grant it once and scanning will work here.
camera_page_desc: SSP Wallet uses your camera only to scan QR codes (addresses and pairing codes). Chrome can only show the permission prompt on a full page like this one — grant it once here and QR scanning will work everywhere in the wallet.
camera_page_granted: Camera access granted. You can close this tab and scan again.
camera_page_blocked: Camera access was blocked. Click the camera icon in the address bar (or Chrome Settings → Privacy → Site settings → Camera) to allow it, then try again.
camera_page_no_camera: No camera was found on this device.
err_invalid_message: Message is too long. Maximum is {{characters}} characters.
err_invalid_xpriv_decrypt: Invalid wallet xpriv, unable to decrypt
err_s1: Code S1: Something went wrong while decrypting password.
contacts_picker: Choose from contacts and my wallets
tx_to_sspkey: Transaction will be sent for approval to your SSP Key.
double_check_tx: Double check the transaction details before you send.
err_tx_size_limit: Transaction size exceeds blockchain limits. Please lower your amount or consolidate UTXOs first.
replace_by_fee_tx: This is a Replace by Fee (RBF) transaction.
replace_by_fee_stop: To cancel Replace by Fee (RBF) transaction, hit Cancel or navigate back by clicking on SSP logo.
err_public_nonces: Public nonces are not available, please sync public nonces from SSP Key first.
err_sol_fee_not_ready: Network fees are still loading. Wait a moment and try again.
err_sol_not_synced: Solana isn't fully synced with your SSP Key yet. Open the Solana chain and complete the sync, then try again.
err_derive_address: Couldn't derive this wallet's address from your SSP Key data. Re-sync this chain with your SSP Key, or restore your wallet if the problem persists.
input_gas_price: Input Base Gas Price in gwei units
input_priority_gas_price: Input Priority Gas Price in gwei units
calculated_gas_limit_description: Total gas is automatically calculated as the sum of the three components above
err_invalid_hex_data: Transaction data must be in valid hex format (0x...)
warn_data_only_eth: Transaction data is only available for {{symbol}} transfers.
warn_token_transfer_override: This appears to be a token transfer. The amount and receiver may be encoded in the transaction data.
preverification_gas_help: Gas used by the bundler to process your transaction before it reaches the blockchain. Covers bundler fees, calldata costs, and account abstraction overhead that isn't metered by the blockchain.
call_gas_limit_help: Maximum gas allocated for executing your actual transaction or smart contract call. This is the main computation limit for your transaction's execution phase.
verification_gas_limit_help: Maximum gas allocated for validating your transaction signature and account permissions. This covers the validation phase of your account abstraction wallet.
total_gas_help: Total maximum gas your transaction can consume. This is the sum of all three components above and represents your transaction's complete gas budget.
base_gas_price_help: Base fee per gas unit required by the network. This is the minimum fee that gets burned according to EIP-1559.
priority_gas_price_help: Priority fee (tip) per gas unit paid to validators/miners to prioritize your transaction. Higher tips result in faster inclusion.
enter_amount_for_fee: Enter an amount to see the fee
err_kas_insufficient_funds: Insufficient balance to cover the amount and the network fee.
err_kas_needs_consolidation: This wallet holds too many small coins to send this amount in one transaction. Send a smaller amount, or send the full balance to yourself first to consolidate.
err_kas_fee_too_high: The network fee exceeds the maximum allowed for one transaction. Try again later or send a smaller amount.
err_kas_change_dust: The leftover change would be too small to keep. Adjust the amount slightly, or use Max.
err_kas_network: Could not reach the Kaspa network. Please try again.
err_kas_vault_mismatch: The derived Kaspa vault does not match this wallet's address. Re-sync this chain with SSP Key.
err_kas_review_changed: Your balance or the network fee changed since you reviewed this transaction. The amount and fee have been updated: review them and confirm again.
err_tron_not_live: TRON vaults are not live yet. Sending is disabled until the SSP TRON contracts are deployed.
err_tron_quote_failed: Could not get a network fee quote from SSP. Please try again.
err_tron_quote_invalid: The network fee quote failed verification on this device and was refused.
err_tron_quote_expired: The fee quote expired and was refreshed. Review the fee and confirm again.
err_tron_vault_mismatch: The derived TRON vault does not match this wallet’s address. Re-sync this chain with SSP Key.
err_tron_recipient_blacklisted: Tether has blacklisted this recipient. USDT sent there would be frozen permanently, so this send is blocked.
err_tron_vault_frozen: Tether has frozen the USDT in this vault. USDT cannot be sent from it.
err_tron_fee_balance: Not enough {{symbol}} in the vault to pay the network fee.
err_tron_fee_too_high: The network fee is above the allowed maximum. Please try again later.
err_tron_network: Could not reach the TRON network. Please try again.
err_tron_key_no_trx: SSP Key’s TRON account needs TRX to submit this transaction itself.
tron_not_live_title: TRON vaults are not live yet
tron_not_live_desc: Your TRON vault address becomes available once the SSP TRON contracts are deployed. Sending is disabled until then.
tron_fee_enter_details: Enter a recipient and an amount to see the network fee.
tron_fee_explainer: SSP pays the energy for this transaction. Your vault pays SSP this fee in the same transaction, once per transaction.
tron_sponsor_unavailable: SSP cannot sponsor this transaction right now. You can pay the network fee yourself instead (Advanced, below).
tron_sponsor_insufficient_fee: This vault does not hold enough TRX or USDT to pay the SSP fee. Add some TRX (about 20 TRX is plenty) or pay the network fee yourself (Advanced, below).
tron_keep_trx_hint: Tip: keep about 20 TRX in this vault. Fees paid in TRX are cheaper than fees paid in USDT.
tron_first_send_note: This is the first transaction of this vault: it also deploys the vault contract, so the fee is higher once.
tron_self_pay_desc: SSP Key submits this transaction from its own TRON account and pays the energy itself, so there is no SSP fee. That account needs enough TRX, usually 10 to 30 TRX.
tron_vault_frozen_banner: Tether has frozen (blacklisted) the USDT held by this vault. USDT cannot leave this vault.
tron_new_recipient_desc: You have not sent to this address before. Scammers create addresses that share the first and last characters with addresses you know. Check every character, especially the highlighted middle.
tron_lookalike_warning: Warning: this address starts and ends like {{known}} but is a different address. Scammers use lookalike addresses to steal funds.
swap_awaiting_quote: Waiting for an exchange rate — this updates automatically.
